description: Mandatory immutable ledger tracking every deleted, unified, moved, or compacted function and struct.

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Hardcoded string literal representing an initializer list expression type in CallChecker, ConversionRankingEngine, SemanticHelpers, and HoverHandler.

entries.ramOrCpuImpact: Zero heap allocations; constexpr string_view sentinel comparison.

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Carried 13 boolean flags, 2 enums, and placement tracking taking 24 bytes.
entries.whyChangedOrDeleted: Compacted using C++20 uint8_t bitfields and enum narrowing to fit exactly into 4 bytes.
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: Compacted from 24 B to 4 B (-83.3% memory reduction, 2.0 MB saved per 100k instances).

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Stored raw parameter text (std::string rawText) and 9 individual bool flags taking 248 bytes.

entries.ramOrCpuImpact: Compacted from 248 B to 200 B (-19.4% memory reduction, 4.8 MB saved per 100k instances).
